evals.prompt: Build a dependency DAG across submodels that share derived parameters and data.
evals.expected_output: Success emits an acyclic model_dag.json plus a rendered model_dag.svg with a critical path.
assertions: every submodel appears as exactly one node
edges capture data and parameter dependencies between submodels
detects and reports cycles instead of emitting an invalid graph
identifies the critical path to guide Programmer parallelization
